verdict.rationale: Ardent branches are isolated copies of your actual production Postgres, from any source (Supabase, RDS, PlanetScale, self-hosted), described as an "exact copy of production" for running full test suites and real query and index validation. A community note says it runs on Neon infrastructure, which is consistent with real Postgres rather than a lookalike. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of extension support and Postgres version parity between source and branch, MySQL/SQLite support, and independent hands-on confirmation of dialect fidelity.
